judgments.scope: Exact selected v2 PNG against whole current373 practical/dye-model goal, its whole d124 direct prerequisite and the two complete authored practical/transfer cases; image compatibility only.
scientificObservations: The power source and chamber consistently label left negative/black and right positive/red. Both wires preserve that assignment.

Both illustrated dye spots carry minus signs and the indicated migration points from the start toward the positive/right electrode: correct for the selected negative dye model. It is not a claim that every amino acid is negative or that anions always travel to the physical right; reversing the poles reverses that side.
The separate planning card shows pH and plus/minus signs without direction arrows. It leaves charge-state/pH/polarity reasoning open rather than drawing incompatible universal migration directions.

The chamber is depicted schematically covered with transparent frame/reflections, connectors outside the cover and no handling person. This is a closed-model illustration, not a certification that a real apparatus or local safety protocol is approved.

The Rohdaten notebook is visibly empty and accompanied by a question symbol. No measured pH, voltage, time or distance, actual observation, learner conduct or successful separation is asserted. The gel spots are illustrative, never learner raw data.
No actor is present; there is no erroneous person-facing notebook/board/scale orientation. Decorative books and the background note impose no extra assessed content.

judgments.scope: Exact TLC PNG against whole new5fd theory/Rf goal, whole two direct prerequisites and both full authored data-only/transfer cases; image compatibility only.
scientificObservations: The TLC startline is above the solvent surface; the plate bottom contacts the mobile phase. The dashed solvent front stops below the plate top. The upward mobile-phase arrow and stationary-phase pointer distinguish the two phases.

The two inset measurement arrows a and b share the same startline. The purple a ends at the purple spot-height guide; b ends at the solvent-front guide. Both are distances along the same migration direction and a<b, consistent with dimensionless Rf=a/b.

The measurement inset is slightly proportionally rescaled rather than aligned pixel-for-pixel with the plate. Approximate visual coordinates: main baseline609/front178/purplecentre356 gives253/431≈0.587; inset baseline609/front197/purpleguide367 gives242/412≈0.587. Drawing/spot-blur tolerance applies; these are illustration checks, not lab measurements. Thus both endpoints represent the same relative migration.

A, B and U visibly share one baseline; upper/lower U spots match the illustrated reference heights under the same pictured conditions. Neither co-migration nor two visible spots is labeled as proof of unique identity, purity, exactly two components or universal Rf.

The large Rf fraction and proportional arrows carry the mathematical relation without units. Colored b and the green lower spots do not contradict its endpoint: b visibly terminates at the front guide, not at that spot.

actualResponsiveObservations.360x203: Start above solvent, front below top, common-origin a/b arrows, upper/lower reference and U spots and the large Rf fraction remain recognizable. Phase labels are compact but readable; no fine tick or microtext is necessary.
actualResponsiveObservations.680x383: Phase pointers, line hierarchy, spot-center/front measurement endpoints and full fraction are clear. Three lanes and distinct upper/lower comparison levels remain easy to follow.
